articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: CISA contractor accidentally turned GitHub into a government key dispensary, exposing AWS GovCloud credentials to anyone with a browser. The agency that's supposed to secure our infrastructure couldn't secure a public repository — peak irony achieved.

articles.title: DNC Autopsy of 2024 Loss Doesn’t Mention Gaza or Israel at all
articles.summary: GitHub got pwned and 4,000 internal repos walked out the door courtesy of TeamPCP. When the platform that hosts everyone's secrets gets its own secrets stolen, the circular firing squad of irony is complete.

articles.title: Attackers spill plaintext passwords of 46k Myspace93 users after 2021 breach
articles.summary: HackerOne slashed bug bounty payouts by 75%, proving they've mastered the art of demotivating the very researchers keeping the internet from burning down. Nothing says 'we value security' like paying researchers in exposure bucks.

articles.title: Microsoft storms RAMPART, adds Clarity to agentic AI safety
articles.summary: Cisco serves up another perfect 10 CVSS score with Secure Workload admin flaw that lets attackers hop tenant boundaries like they're playing corporate hopscotch. Switchzilla strikes again with APIs more permeable than a coffee filter.

articles.title: When Identity is the Attack Path
articles.summary: Microsoft Defender has two actively exploited vulns — a privilege escalation and DoS flaw that turn your security software into an attack vector. The irony of your antivirus becoming the virus is *chef's kiss* beautiful.

articles.title: Linus Torvalds admits he has a 'love-hate relationship with AI'
articles.summary: Nine-year-old Linux kernel flaw finally crawls out of the shadows, enabling root command execution across major distros. Sometimes the best hiding spots are in plain sight, buried in code everyone trusts.

articles.title: Your Privacy Shouldn't Be A Corporate Decision
articles.summary: Microsoft took baby steps toward human rights accountability while Google and Amazon continue enabling authoritarian regimes with cloud infrastructure. EFF calls out the tech giants who profit from oppression while hiding behind terms of service.

articles.title: AI Agents Are Shifting Identity Security Budget Dynamics
articles.summary: EFF drops a new guide fighting digital surveillance abuses across the Americas, where accountability is optional and human rights violations are the feature, not the bug. Systematic oppression needs systematic resistance.

articles.title: Cyber resilience defines SME competitiveness
articles.summary: Microsoft patches YellowKey BitLocker bypass by neutering the FsTx Auto Recovery Utility — turns out your disk encryption was one utility away from being useless. Sometimes the best fix is just turning off the broken thing.

articles.title: 🔒 A Win for Encrypted Messaging | EFFector 38.10
articles.summary: Scattered Spider's 'Tylerb' pleads guilty to wire fraud and identity theft after SMS phishing campaigns that made corporate security look like amateur hour. Another legend falls, but the techniques live on in the wild.
